title: Delegated publish approval: an editor agent may approve after a person's deadline passes
description: Third publish-gate setting (after required / not_required, PPY-8c5438): a person gets first refusal for a site-configured time; if nobody answers, the editor agent may approve only when its review passes the story's acceptance criteria and the Humanus check has no error findings; otherwise keep waiting. Record the approval as delegated (agent, evidence), surface it in the Notification Center, allow pulling the story afterwards. Anth.us stays required (Ryan 2026-10-31).
